messages.content: Hello Arjun, I'd like to conduct our daily standup. Can you please tell me what you worked on yesterday, specifically in relation to your assigned sprint tickets, such as [PROJ-101] or [PROJ-103]?
Arjun, moving on to today, what tasks do you plan to work on, and will you be focusing on making progress with [PROJ-101], starting [PROJ-102], or addressing the [PROJ-103] token expiry bug?
i already gave your the update

Arjun, I apologize for the misunderstanding. Since you didn't provide any work done yesterday, let's move on to potential blockers. Are you currently facing any obstacles or challenges that might hinder your progress on your assigned sprint tickets, such as [PROJ-101] or [PROJ-103]?

I will note your standup update and flag any blockers for the Scrum Master.
Hello Sarah, let's begin the daily standup. Can you tell me what you worked on yesterday?
Can you tell me what ticekts are assigned to me

Sarah, you have three sprint tickets assigned to you: [PROJ-104] Design and build the main dashboard UI, which is currently in progress, [PROJ-105] Create reusable card and table components, which is marked as done, and [PROJ-106] Accessibility audit for dashboard screens, which is still to do. Now, can you tell me what you worked on yesterday?
i have worked on 104 and completed the design dashboard
Sarah, that's a good update on [PROJ-104]. You've completed the design for the main dashboard UI. What are you planning to work on today?
i am planning to do the unit testing of it today.

Sarah, unit testing is a crucial step for [PROJ-104]. Are you experiencing any blockers or challenges that might hinder your progress on this task or any other assigned tickets, such as [PROJ-106] which is still pending?
i dont have any blockers , but i need pwa access

Sarah, I've noted that you need PWA access. I'll flag this as a potential blocker and notify the Scrum Master to assist with providing the necessary access. Thank you, Sarah, that's everything I need for today's standup. Your update has been recorded and your Scrum Master will be notified. Have a productive day!
